records.name: Native American LifeLines, Inc.
records.what: An Urban Indian Organization funded by the Indian Health Service. The Indian Health Service lists it as offering help finding and getting to health care (outreach and referral).
records.who: American Indian and Alaska Native people living in or near the city. Ask what proof of tribal affiliation or descent it needs.
records.start: Call and ask how to become a patient or client, and which services are offered at the site nearest you.

more.label: Indian Health Service directory of Urban Indian Organizations (phone numbers and websites)

records.name: Massachusetts Commission on Indian Affairs
records.what: A state commission, created in 1974, whose job is to help Native American people, tribes and organizations deal with state and local government agencies. Its page also explains the state's Native American tuition credit.
records.who: Native American people, tribes and organizations in Massachusetts.
records.start: Call the main office of the state housing agency the commission belongs to and ask for the Commission on Indian Affairs.
records.phone_note: Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities main office
